general.name: Connection Health - Ping Targets Not Responding [Win]
general.description: Alerts when hosts stop answering ping, such as the far side of a site-to-site tunnel. Read-only. Bad input or a failed check also alerts. https://github.com/TechCollective/DattoRMM_Components

variables.name: usrTargets
variables.description: Required. 1-8 IPs or hostnames to ping, space or comma separated. Use hosts that are always on (e.g. the far gateway LAN IP).

variables.name: usrRequire
variables.description: Any: alert only when no target replies. All: alert when any target does not reply.

variables.name: usrReplyTimeoutSec
variables.description: 1-5. Seconds to wait for each reply.
